prompt: Choose an AI tool used at a university or workplace. Answer the five questions about it in one sentence each, or say where you could not find an answer.

criteria.label: Who it was tested on
criteria.look_for: an answer or a noted gap about the test groups

criteria.label: Errors and who pays
criteria.look_for: the kinds of errors and who bears their cost

criteria.label: Who checks the decision
criteria.look_for: whether a person with authority reviews and can override the output

reference: Tool: an AI-text detector. 1. I could not find who it was tested on. 2. No accuracy by group is published. 3. It makes false positives (human work flagged) and false negatives. 4. A falsely flagged student pays with time and trust; the appeal route is unclear. 5. The policy says an instructor must review flags before any action.
